facts.text: Through EMU's 4WARD Graduation Scholarship, students who complete their first two years living on campus receive full tuition funding for their remaining two years.

sources.title: Attend college with free tuition, 4WARD Graduation Scholarship
sources.quote: When you successfully complete two years at Eastern Michigan University, we will fund your full tuition for your remaining two years.
